shortDescription: List and filter on VPC Subnets.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of VPC Subnets to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting VPC Subnets.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list VPC Subnets in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order VPC Subnets by.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: The parent VPC for the VPC Subnets.
